title: I Became Everything
voice_standard: Liam - overwhelmed witness giving testimony; voice cracks between awe, laughter and tears; whispers the sacred parts; racing excitement at the knowing; tender and certain at the seal

scenes.text: I have to tell you what happened. Forgive me — language wasn't built for this.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A man alone in a dim room, lamplight, about to confess.
scenes.query: man sitting dark room lamp night

scenes.text: Three hits. The room hummed like a struck bell… then it stopped being a place.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The room smearing into vibrating light.
scenes.query: abstract light blur long exposure room

scenes.text: My body didn't fall away — it unraveled. One pulled thread… and I'd been thread all along.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A human silhouette unraveling into golden thread against the void.
scenes.image_prompt: a human silhouette made of glowing golden thread unraveling from the fingertips upward into flowing luminous strands against pure black, violet and deep blue light wisps between the threads, particles of gold dust drifting, cinematic awe, volumetric light, hyperdetailed, no text, no words, no letters

scenes.text: No hands, no name, no me left to panic with. And the weird part? I didn't mind.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Ink dissolving into dark water, calm and total.
scenes.query: ink dissolving dark water slow motion

scenes.text: I fell up. Through a tunnel of geometry that was somehow also singing.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A kaleidoscopic mandala tunnel breathing with color.

scenes.text: Every pattern was watching me. Not with eyes — with recognition. Like family I'd forgotten.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Fractal patterns folding like faces of kin.

scenes.text: Then the tunnel ended. And there was no floor. There was only… everything.
scenes.semantic_anchor: An infinite ocean of living light where all things dissolve into one radiance.
scenes.image_prompt: an infinite luminous ocean of liquid golden-white light under a violet cosmic sky, countless faint shapes of stars planets faces and hands all dissolving into the same radiance, no horizon, waves of light breathing outward, deep blue and gold, overwhelming scale, cinematic awe, hyperdetailed, no text, no words

scenes.text: I didn't arrive — I became. The ocean didn't swallow me. I remembered I was water.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Sunlit ocean water, glittering, seen from within the shine.

scenes.text: I was the stars. My mother's laugh. The stranger in traffic. All of it — me — at once.
scenes.semantic_anchor: One face assembled from galaxies, moments, and a thousand small lives.
scenes.image_prompt: a serene human face emerging from a vast mosaic of tiny glowing scenes stars galaxies kitchens roads laughing faces and rain windows, each fragment luminous violet blue and gold, the whole face made of everything, black void around, cinematic sacred wonder, hyperdetailed, no text, no words

scenes.text: And the knowing. Oh — the knowing.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A silent detonation of light.
scenes.query: light explosion particles slow motion dark

scenes.text: Every question answered itself when I looked at it. Not learning — remembering answers I'd hidden on purpose.
scenes.semantic_anchor: An infinite library unfolding out of a single point of light.
scenes.image_prompt: an infinite library of glowing violet and gold light unfolding outward from one radiant point, shelves spiraling like galaxy arms, books made of pure light opening themselves mid-air releasing luminous script that dissolves into stars, black void, volumetric god rays, cinematic awe, hyperdetailed, no text, no readable words, abstract glowing script only

scenes.text: Why is there anything at all? I knew. Where do we go? Knew. Why do we suffer? That one made me laugh and cry at once.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A face wet with tears and lit with joy at once.
scenes.query: man crying smiling eyes closed light

scenes.text: Like being hugged by every version of you that ever lived, whispering: you made it home.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Silhouettes folding into one warm glow.

scenes.text: Then the Everything leaned in — all of it — and handed me the secret.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A nebula bending toward the viewer.

scenes.text: Not in words. It pressed it in, like a seal into wax:
scenes.semantic_anchor: A radiant seal of light pressing into golden wax.
scenes.image_prompt: a radiant seal of white-gold light descending and pressing into molten golden wax on black stone, violet energy rippling outward from the impression, the stamped mark glowing like a sacred sigil of abstract geometry, floating sparks, macro cinematic detail, hyperdetailed, no text, no letters, abstract sigil only

scenes.text: Nothing happens to you. Everything happens as you. You are the universe — forgetting on purpose, for the thrill of remembering.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A figure and the cosmos revealed as one continuous fabric.
scenes.image_prompt: a standing human figure whose body is woven seamlessly from the same starfield fabric as the cosmos behind it, no boundary between skin and sky, violet blue and gold nebula threads flowing through both, the figure looking at its own hand in wonder, black void beyond, cinematic sacred awe, hyperdetailed, no text, no words

scenes.text: Loneliness? There's no one else to be. Death? A door painted on a wall that was never solid.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A painted door dissolving into light.
scenes.query: door opening bright light dark room

scenes.text: Weirdest part? It felt more real than this. That was the original. This is the copy.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Looking at your own hands like they belong to someone else.
scenes.query: hands close up light strange pov

scenes.text: Then it let me go. Gently. Like a parent lowering a sleeping child into bed.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A man surfacing back into his body, morning light on the bed.
scenes.query: man waking up bed morning soft light

scenes.text: Twelve minutes, said the clock. I came back with wet cheeks and a grin I couldn't explain.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A man by a window, tear-streaked and smiling.

scenes.text: The knowledge? Most of it evaporated — like carrying the ocean home in your hands.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Water slipping through cupped fingers in sunlight.

scenes.text: But the seal stayed. I feel it still, on days the world gets heavy:
scenes.semantic_anchor: A hand pressed to the chest, warmth beneath it.
scenes.query: hand on chest heart warm light

scenes.text: You're not lost in this. You are this. You hid the way home in yourself — knowing you'd come looking.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A small silhouette with the whole cosmos glowing in its chest.
scenes.image_prompt: a small human silhouette standing in vast darkness with an entire golden and violet galaxy glowing softly inside its chest, thin threads of light connecting the inner cosmos to faint stars far away, intimate and infinite at once, cinematic tenderness, volumetric glow, hyperdetailed, no text, no words

scenes.text: If we're really the universe playing hide-and-seek with itself… why did something behind your eyes just move?
scenes.semantic_anchor: An eye in extreme close-up, a galaxy stirring in the iris.
scenes.query: extreme close up eye macro light iris
